float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: Both instances evaluate cos and sin in floating point; the difference is the f32 rounding of the angle (up to 1.8 rad, ulp 1.2e-7 rad = 0.004 LSB); measured 0.002 LSB

fixed_vs_float.rationale: Phase rounded to 12 table bits: error at most pi/4096 rad = 25.1 LSB at amplitude 1, plus up to 1.5 LSB from table amplitude and quantisation; rms -> 67.1 dB (measured 25.6 LSB, 67.2 dB)
Phase rounded to 14 table bits: error at most pi/16384 rad = 6.3 LSB at amplitude 1, plus up to 0.5 LSB; rms -> 79.1 dB (measured 6.4 LSB, 79.2 dB)
